acquisition method: targeted mass difference (TMD); data dependent acquisition (DDA)
analysis by a single LC-MS/MS run using targeted mass difference (TMD)
alkylation reagent: denatured with 2% SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM chloroacetamide
alkylation concentration: denatured with 2% SDS, 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 8, 150 mM NaCl, 10 mM TCEP, 40 mM chloroacetamide

collision energy: fragmented using HCD with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 35%
enrichment method: carried out mitochondrial isolation before pooling samples

fragmentation method: fragmented using HCD with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 35%
instrument: Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer; QExactive HF
sprayed into an Orbitrap Fusion Lumos Tribrid Mass Spectrometer (ThermoFisher Scientific)
labeling: introduce mePRODmt, a pulsed-SILAC based proteomics approach
mass analyzer: fragmented using HCD with a normalized collision energy (NCE) of 35% and analyzed in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 50,000 at m/z 200
precursor tolerance: Precursor mass tolerance was set to 10 ppm
fragment tolerance: fragment mass tolerance was set to 0.02 Da

TMT6 (+229.163) for TMT 11 plex and TMTpro (+304.207) for TMT 16 plex at the N terminus and carbamidomethyl (+57.021) at cysteine residues were set as fixed modifications. TMT6 (K, +229.163), TMT6+K8 (K, +237.177), Arg10 (R, +10.008) for TMT 11 plex, and TMTpro (K, +304.207), TMTpro+K8 (K, +312.221), Arg10 (R, +10.008) for TMT 16 plex, and methionine oxidation (M, +15.995) as well as Met-loss + Acetyl (M, −89.030) at the protein N terminus were set for dynamic modifications.
